// diagnostic

E0079

This effect-only loop uses a result exit.

What

This effect-only loop uses a result exit.

Why

A break payload makes an effect-only loop a value expression.

Fix

Bind the loop with `::`, or remove the payload.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0079: tests/ui/effect_loop_break_payload.stderr.

Error [E0079]: this effect-only loop uses a result exit
  --> tests/ui/effect_loop_break_payload.jet:3:9
    |
  3 |         break 1
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: a break payload makes an effect-only loop a value expression
 Fix: bind the loop with `::`, or remove the payload
